ZULULANG 1: First year, first quarter Zulu is the first course in a three-quarter sequence. The course emphasizes developing basic communication skills using daily and cultural life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational modes of communication.
ZULULANG 2: First year, second quarter Zulu is the second course in a three-quarter sequence. The course emphasizes developing basic communication skills using daily and cultural life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational modes of communication. Continuation of ZULULANG 1. Prerequisite ZULULANG 1.
ZULULANG 3: First year, third quarter Zulu is the third course in a three-quarter sequence. The course emphasizes developing basic communication skills using daily and cultural life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational modes of communication. Continuation of ZULULANG 2. Prerequisite ZULULANG 2. Fulfills the University Foreign Language Requirement.
